---
title: "Sample state & protocol"
---

```{python}
from _lib import *
met = read("validation_metrics")
res = read("spectral_residuals")
```

Leaf RTMs describe intact, hydrated leaves. The library also contains:

* dried intact leaves
* herbarium-pressed leaves
* ground powders (e.g. SHIFT, NEON, Sierra Nevada 2023), sometimes from the same leaves

All of them are fitted. This page shows where the models' assumptions break down. It also
compares measurement protocols (integrating sphere vs leaf clip vs contact probe), because
they differ in illumination geometry and in what "reflectance" means.

## Retrieval by sample state

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "R² (log scale) of estimate vs measurement by sample state, per trait (Hetero + OU, PROSPECT-D)."
if len(met):
    m = met[(met["group"] == "all") & (met["model"] == "prospectd") & (met["errmodel"] == "ou")
            & ~met["rt"].astype(bool) & (met["data_use"] == "all")].dropna(subset=["r2_log"])
    fig = go.Figure()
    for st, g in m.groupby("sample_state"):
        fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=g["trait"].map(lambda t: trait_label(t, False)), y=g["r2_log"], name=st,
                             marker=dict(color=STATE_COLOR.get(st, MUTED), line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=2)),
                             customdata=g["n"], hovertemplate="%{x}: R² %{y:.2f} (n = %{customdata})<extra>" + st + "</extra>"))
    fig.update_layout(barmode="group", yaxis_title="R² (log)", yaxis_range=[0, 1], height=400,
                      legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.12))
    show(fig)
else:
    no_data()
```

## Spectral residuals by sample state

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Mean reflectance residual by wavelength for each sample state (PROSPECT-D, Hetero + OU)."
if len(res):
    r = res[(res["model"] == "prospectd") & (res["errmodel"] == "ou") & (res["quantity"] == "R") & res["fitted"]
            & ~res["rt"].astype(bool) & (res["data_use"] == "all")]
    fig = go.Figure()
    for st, g in r.groupby("sample_state"):
        g = g.sort_values("wl_bin")
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=g["wl_bin"], y=g["resid_mean"], mode="lines", name=st,
                                 line=dict(color=STATE_COLOR.get(st, MUTED), width=2)))
    fig.add_hline(y=0, line=dict(color=AXIS, width=1))
    fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="wavelength (nm)", yaxis_title="mean residual (R)", height=380,
                      legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.12))
    show(fig)
```

## By dataset

```{python}
#| tbl-cap: "Retrieval metrics per dataset (PROSPECT-D, Hetero + OU). Datasets differ in protocol (sphere, clip, probe), instrument and plant material."
if len(met):
    d = met[met["group"].str.startswith("dataset:") & (met["model"] == "prospectd") & (met["errmodel"] == "ou")
            & ~met["rt"].astype(bool) & (met["data_use"] == "all")].copy()
    d["dataset"] = d["group"].str.removeprefix("dataset:")
    show_table(fmt(d[["dataset", "sample_state", "trait", "n", "r2_log", "bias_log", "coverage90", "crps_log"]]))
```
